question: The Tokyo Paralympics 2020 gold medal winner Krishna Nagar is associated with _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**badminton**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Krishna Nagar won the gold medal in badminton at the Tokyo Paralympics 2020.
 
• This achievement marked a significant moment in India's performance at the Paralympic Games.
 
• Krishna Nagar competed in the Men's Singles SH6 category.
 
• His victory added to India's growing success in para-badminton on the international stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Tokyo Paralympics 2020 saw India achieving its best-ever medal tally.
 
• Para-badminton was included in the Paralympic Games for the first time in Tokyo 2020.
 
• India's success in para-badminton at the Tokyo Paralympics has inspired many aspiring athletes with disabilities.
 
• The Indian government and various sports organizations have been increasingly supporting para-athletes through various initiatives and funding.
